summary: Vampire: The Masquerade game entries track the World of Darkness PC/console adaptations and their patch/mod-dependent preservation routes.

entries.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines

primary.why: Bloodlines is a Windows-only Source-engine RPG whose modern playability depends on patch state. GOG distributes the game with an Unofficial Patch route, while Steam/raw installs often need manual fixes; use the PC build and record whether Basic or Plus patch content is used.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG or owned PC release with Unofficial Patch Basic for a conservative first archive run. Record storefront, patch version, Basic vs Plus, clan, build, resolution/FOV fixes, widescreen/settings, quest state, and whether restored/Plus content was included or excluded.
